Parcats dimension objects

Source: R/zz-gen-parcats.R
go_parcats_dimension.Rd

The dimensions (variables) of the parallel categories diagram. The object for an element of the dimensions list of a parcats trace (go_parcats()). go_parcats_dimension() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_parcats_dimension(
  ...,
  categoryarray = NULL,
  categoryorder = NULL,
  displayindex = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  ticktext = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

categoryarray

Sets the order in which categories in this dimension appear. Only has an effect if `categoryorder` is set to "array". Used with `categoryorder`. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

categoryorder

Specifies the ordering logic for the categories in the dimension. By default, plotly uses "trace", which specifies the order that is present in the data supplied. Set `categoryorder` to "category ascending" or "category descending" if order should be determined by the alphanumerical order of the category names. Set `categoryorder` to "array" to derive the ordering from the attribute `categoryarray`. If a category is not found in the `categoryarray` array, the sorting behavior for that attribute will be identical to the "trace" mode. The unspecified categories will follow the categories in `categoryarray`. One of "trace", "category ascending", "category descending", "array".

displayindex

The display index of dimension, from left to right, zero indexed, defaults to dimension index. Integer.

label

The shown name of the dimension. String.

ticktext

Sets alternative tick labels for the categories in this dimension. Only has an effect if `categoryorder` is set to "array". Should be an array the same length as `categoryarray` Used with `categoryorder`. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

values

Dimension values. `values[n]` represents the category value of the `n`th point in the dataset, therefore the `values` vector for all dimensions must be the same (longer vectors will be truncated). Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

visible

Shows the dimension when set to `true` (the default). Hides the dimension for `false`. Logical.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_parcats_dimension object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

go_parcats(
  dimensions = list(go_parcats_dimension(visible = TRUE))
)
#> <go_parcats>
#> {
#>   "type": "parcats",
#>   "dimensions": [
#>     {
#>       "visible": true
#>     }
#>   ]
#> }
#>
